summary: Tested the lookahead-boundary change on Home/Learn (index.tsx). Logged in as demo@tradequest.app (Level 1), confirmed only 11 units (revealedMax=10) rendered with no locked placeholders/level-numbers beyond boundary, and single-page pager correctly hidden (totalPages=1). Used backend API (POST /api/lessons/{id}/complete) to advance the demo user to currentUnitIndex=15 (revealedMax=25) to force a 2-page scenario and re-tested pagination, finding a real bug in the top-pager label. Restored demo user's progress to Level 1/0 XP afterward so downstream test iterations aren't affected.

ui_bugs.issue: BUG: On page 2 (currentUnitIndex=15, revealedMax=25), the top pager label reads 'LEVEL 21-40', but only units 21-26 are actually revealed/rendered on that page (units 27-40 are completely absent, per the intended lookahead behavior). rangeEnd is computed as Math.min(units.length, safePage*PAGE_SIZE+PAGE_SIZE) using the TRUE total (units.length=200) instead of being capped at revealedMax+1. This directly contradicts the task requirement that pager labels 'only ever reflect the revealed range, never implying' content beyond it -- a low-level user sees a page labeled up to level 40 while the page body stops rendering at level 26, which is misleading/inconsistent with the rest of the fix.

action_items: Fix rangeEnd (and any other range-end calc used for pager labels, e.g. bottom pager's next-preview range) to cap at Math.min(revealedMax + 1, safePage*PAGE_SIZE+PAGE_SIZE) instead of units.length, so the top-pager label never advertises levels beyond what is actually rendered on that page.

Re-verify pull-to-refresh (RefreshControl) and elastic-bounce removal on a native device/simulator -- browser automation on web preview cannot reliably simulate native touch-drag overscroll or pull-to-refresh gestures, so this specific sub-requirement was NOT fully verified (see notes below).
critical_code_review_comments: revealedMax/pageUnits.map guard (absIndex > revealedMax -> return null) works correctly: verified via DOM/body-text inspection that no level-number, lock icon, or placeholder text exists beyond the boundary in both the 1-page (revealedMax=10) and 2-page (revealedMax=25) scenarios.
Bottom pager's disabled Next button correctly omits the level-range preview text when disabled (verified: 'safePage < totalPages - 1' guard around the Text) -- this matches spec.
Bottom pager's Prev-side label (Math.max(1, rangeStart-PAGE_SIZE)-Math.max(PAGE_SIZE, rangeStart-1)) is correct and unaffected.

pager-prev/pager-next and bottom prev/next navigation both work correctly across pages 1<->2; lesson-node tap navigation to /lesson/{id} for an unlocked/current lesson within the revealed range works correctly (regression pass).

bounces={false} + overScrollMode='never' + RefreshControl coexistence could not be exercised via Playwright web automation (native touch-drag/elastic-bounce gestures aren't reproducible in a headless browser); this needs manual/device verification per the agent-to-agent note's specific ask.

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend-only scope; used API only as test helper)
success_rate.frontend: ~85% (5/6 explicit scenarios passed; 1 pager-label bug found; bounce/pull-to-refresh not verifiable in this environment)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily completed lessons l1-l45 for demo@tradequest.app via API to force currentUnitIndex=15 (2-page scenario) for boundary testing, then restored the account to completed_lessons=[], xp=0, level=1 directly in MongoDB after testing -- no lasting seed data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: demo@tradequest.app is restored to Level 1/0 XP as before. To reproduce the 2-page pager-label bug quickly: login, then POST /api/lessons/{id}/complete (body {score,total,correct}) for lesson ids l1..l45 (units u1-u15) to push currentUnitIndex to 15, reload Home, click pager-next -> top pager shows 'LEVEL 21-40' while only levels 21-26 render. Remember to reset completed_lessons/xp/level back to empty/0/1 for the demo user afterward via Mongo if you do this again.
rca_of_issue: rangeEnd in index.tsx uses `Math.min(units.length, safePage*PAGE_SIZE+PAGE_SIZE)` where units.length is the full curriculum length (200), not the revealed boundary. It should instead be capped by `revealedMax` (e.g. `Math.min(revealedMax + 1, safePage*PAGE_SIZE+PAGE_SIZE)`) so the displayed range never exceeds what pageUnits.map actually renders for that page.
